results.name: Ab Wheel Plank
instructions: Start by kneeling on a mat with the ab wheel placed on the floor in front of you, holding it with both hands. Ensure your arms are extended and your back is straight.
Roll the ab wheel forward until your body is in a plank position, with your arms extended and your body forming a straight line from head to knees.
Hold the plank position, keeping your core engaged and your body stable, as long as required.
Roll the ab wheel back to the starting position.
tips: Keep your spine neutral and avoid letting your lower back sag. This helps protect your spine and ensures proper form.
Focus on engaging your entire core, including your abdominals, obliques, and lower back, to maintain stability.
Roll out and back in with controlled movements to maximize muscle engagement and minimize the risk of injury.
results.description: Ab Wheel Plank is an intermediate multi-joint compound static exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with a wheel roller, it falls under the yoga category. Secondary muscles: Obliques, Hip Flexors.

results.name: Alternate Sprinter Lunge
instructions: Stand with your feet hip-width apart.
Lunge back with your right leg, bending both knees to lower your body into a lunge position while reaching your hands towards your left foot.
Push off your right foot to return to the starting position.
Lunge back with your left leg, reaching your hands towards your right foot. Continue alternating sides.
tips: Keep your core engaged to maintain balance and stability throughout the exercise.
Ensure your front knee does not extend past your toes to avoid strain on your knee joint.
Perform the movement slowly and with control to maximize muscle activation and prevent injury.
results.description: Alternate Sprinter Lunge is an intermediate multi-joint compound static exercise targeting the quads (upper legs). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the yoga category. Secondary muscles: Hip Flexors, Calves.

results.name: Alternating Leg Downward Dog
instructions: Start in a downward dog position with your hands and feet on the mat, hips lifted towards the ceiling, and body forming an inverted V shape.
Bend your right knee towards your chest, keeping your foot on the floor and maintaining balance on your left foot and both hands.
Straighten your right leg back to the starting position.
Bend your left knee towards your chest while maintaining balance. Continue alternating sides.
tips: Keep your core engaged to maintain stability and balance throughout the exercise.
Focus on keeping your hips squared and aligned with the mat to avoid twisting your body.
Perform the movement slowly and with control to maximize muscle activation and prevent injury.
results.description: Alternating Leg Downward Dog is an intermediate multi-joint compound static exercise targeting the hamstrings (upper legs). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the yoga category. Secondary muscles: Calves, Core.

results.name: Alternating Lunge With Rotation
instructions: Start in a plank position with your hands directly under your shoulders and your body forming a straight line from head to heels.
Step your right foot forward, placing it outside your right hand, and rotate your torso to the right, extending your right arm towards the ceiling.
Return your right hand and foot to the plank position.

Step your left foot forward, placing it outside your left hand, and rotate your torso to the left, extending your left arm towards the ceiling. Return to the plank position. Continue alternating sides.
tips: Keep your core engaged to maintain stability and proper alignment throughout the movement.
Ensure your front knee is aligned with your ankle and does not extend past your toes to avoid strain on your knee joint.
Perform the movement slowly and with control to maximize muscle activation and prevent injury.
results.description: Alternating Lunge With Rotation is an intermediate multi-joint compound static exercise targeting the quads (upper legs). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the yoga category. Secondary muscles: Obliques, Hip Flexors, Triceps.

results.name: Archer Step Back
instructions: Stand tall with your back straight and feet shoulder-width apart.
Extend your arms forward while keeping your palms inward.
Take a step backward by extending your left leg behind you while taking your elbow past your back like an archer.
Hold for a while, return to the initial position, and repeat by taking your right leg backward.
tips: Engage your core to maintain balance and stability throughout the exercise.
Ensure your front knee is aligned with your ankle and does not extend past your toes to avoid strain on your knee joint.
Perform the movement with controlled motions to maximize muscle activation and prevent injury.
results.description: Archer Step Back is an advanced multi-joint compound static exercise targeting the quads (upper legs). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the yoga category. Secondary muscles: Obliques, Hip Flexors.

results.name: Basic Toe Touch
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Bend at the hips and reach down towards your toes, keeping your legs as straight as possible.
Hold the stretch for a few seconds, feeling the stretch in your hamstrings and lower back.
Return to the standing position and repeat the movement.
tips: Keep your back straight as you bend to avoid straining your lower back.
Avoid bouncing or jerking movements; perform the stretch slowly and with control.
Breathe deeply and steadily to help relax your muscles and enhance the stretch.
results.description: Basic Toe Touch is an intermediate multi-joint compound static exercise targeting the hamstrings (upper legs). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the yoga category. Secondary muscles: Lower Back, Glutes.

results.name: Bench Reverse Plank Hold
instructions: Place your feet on a bench with your legs extended and your hands on the floor directly under your shoulders, arms straight.
Lift your hips straight until torso comes parallel to the floor.
Hold this position, keeping your core engaged and maintaining a straight line from head to heels.
Maintain the hold for the designated period, focusing on stability and muscle engagement.
tips: Engage your core and glutes to maintain a straight and stable torso throughout the hold.
Keep your elbows slightly bent to avoid locking your joints and ensure muscle engagement.
Breathe steadily and avoid holding your breath to maintain control and endurance during the hold.
results.description: Bench Reverse Plank Hold is an intermediate multi-joint compound static exercise targeting the triceps (upper arms). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the yoga category. Secondary muscles: Chest.

results.name: Bicycle Air Legs
instructions: Lie on your back and lift your hips off the floor, supporting them with your hands while keeping your elbows on the floor.
Perform a bicycle motion with your legs by extending your right leg straight forward while bending your left knee towards the floor.
Switch legs by extending your left leg straight forward and bending your right knee towards the floor, continuing the bicycle motion.
Maintain a controlled and steady pace throughout the exercise.
tips: Ensure your hands are firmly supporting your lower back to maintain proper alignment and stability.
Focus on engaging your core muscles to control the movement of your legs and prevent lower back strain.
Ensure your movements are smooth and controlled to maximize muscle activation and prevent injury.
results.description: Bicycle Air Legs is an intermediate multi-joint compound static exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the yoga category. Secondary muscles: Quadriceps, Hamstrings.

results.name: Bird Dog (Version 2)
instructions: Start in a tabletop position on your hands and knees, with your wrists aligned under your shoulders and your knees under your hips.
Extend your left leg backward, and right arm forward simultaneously, keeping your extending arm straight, until both are slightly higher than torso level.
Hold this position briefly, maintaining balance and stability.
Return to the starting position and repeat the movement with your left arm and right leg.
tips: Engage your core to maintain stability and prevent your back from sagging.
Keep your movements slow and controlled to maximize muscle activation and improve balance.
Maintain a neutral spine position by looking down at the floor during the exercise.
results.description: Bird Dog (Version 2) is a beginner multi-joint compound static exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the yoga category. Secondary muscles: Shoulders, Hip Flexors.

results.name: Bird Dog (Version 3)
instructions: Start in a tabletop position on your hands and knees, with your wrists aligned under your shoulders and your knees under your hips.
Extend your left leg backward, toes extended back, and right arm forward simultaneously, keeping your extending arm straight, until both are parallel to the floor.
Hold this position briefly, maintaining balance and stability.
Return to the starting position and repeat the movement with your left arm and right leg.
tips: Engage your core to maintain stability and prevent your back from sagging.
Keep your movements slow and controlled to maximize muscle activation and improve balance.
Focus on keeping your extended arm and leg parallel to the floor to ensure proper form.
results.description: Bird Dog (Version 3) is a beginner multi-joint compound static exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the yoga category. Secondary muscles: Shoulders, Hip Flexors.
